title: GraphSmith approved-signer registry (R3)
description: The set of signer keys a verifier trusts, with lifecycle status (active / rotated / revoked) and rotation chaining. Trust of a signer remains the verifier's policy (GSA-SPEC §5.5); this registry is how a verifier expresses that policy over time. C1: `added_at` is evidence, never a decision input. Frozen Wave 0 (v0.4.0).

status.description: revoked/rotated => fail-closed for new signatures; a signature valid at sign time may still verify if the registry records the key was active then (verifier policy).

rotated_to.description: signer_id of the successor key when status=rotated (rotation chain).

added_at.description: Evidence only (C1); never a decision input.
